en: Muhammad ibn Muslim ibn Ubayd Allah al-Zuhri
tr: Muhammed b. Müslim b. Ubeydullah ez-Zührî
ar: محمد بن مسلم بن عبيد الله الزهري

description.tr: Hadis ilmi metodolojisinin babası; isnad zincirleriyle hadisleri devlet emriyle ilk sistematik derleyen || Zührî, hadisin sözlü ve yazılı geleneği arasında köprü kurdu. || [Tarih notu] Hadis tedvinindeki resmî rolü sonraki alimler tarafından ittifakla kabul edilir.
description.en: Father of hadith science methodology; first to systematically compile hadith with isnād chains on state order || Al-Zuhri bridged the oral and written traditions of hadith. His codification under Caliph Umar II was the first official state-sponsored hadith project. || [Historiographical note] His role in the official codification (tadwīn) of hadith is unanimously attested by later scholars.
description.ar: أب علم منهج الحديث || جسر الزهري بين التقليد الشفهي والكتابي للحديث
